flight.lowOrbit: Insufficient delta-v: {haveMs} m/s available, {needMs} m/s required.
orbit.batteryDead: Battery depleted: {haveWh} Wh available, {needWh} Wh required in eclipse.
orbit.insufficientData: Insufficient data delivered: {deliveredMb} Mb delivered, {requiredMb} Mb required.

mission.earthObserver.title: Earth Observer
mission.earthObserver.brief: Put an imaging satellite into low Earth orbit and deliver enough data to meet the science team's requirements.
agency.borealis.name: Borealis Federation
agency.borealis.description: Large budget and the full range of launchers. Strong in software and electronics, weak in metallurgy.
agency.monsoon.name: Monsoon Union
agency.monsoon.description: Small budget, cheap launchers and strong software. No heavy launcher.
agency.kestrel.name: Kestrel Republic
agency.kestrel.description: Cheap launchers and strong heavy industry, weaker electronics and optics. Sanctions block the large camera and antenna, so they have to be developed at home.
agency.meridia.name: Meridia Concord
agency.meridia.description: Average budget, very strong optics. Careful development takes longer.
ui.lobby.title: Consortium lobby
ui.lobby.hintLocal: Everyone plays at this screen. Add players and let each pick a country; the agencies take turns designing a spacecraft for the same mission.
ui.lobby.hintOnline: Pick a country and mark yourself ready. The host starts the mission when everyone is ready.
ui.lobby.coinPending: contested: decided by a coin toss at the start
ui.lobby.coinHint: Two players want the same country: a coin toss decides it when the mission starts.
ui.menu.title: Consortium
ui.menu.localHint: Everyone takes turns on this device.
ui.menu.onlineHint: Or play online: create a room and share its code, or join a friend's room.
ui.menu.name: Your name
ui.menu.roomGone: The room is gone: the server restarted or the room expired. Create a new one.
ui.lobby.unknownAgency: The room uses a country that is not available.
ui.lobby.notReady: Waiting for everyone to be ready.
ui.actionsLeft: {n} controls left to adjust this turn (a control you already touched stays free)
ui.marginHint.dv: Speed change the engine can produce. It must be enough to reach the orbit.
ui.marginHint.energy: The battery must keep the spacecraft alive in the planet's shadow.
ui.marginHint.link: Data you can send down per orbit must cover what the camera collects.
ui.marginHint.science: Smallest visible detail. Smaller is sharper, and science needs at most the required value.
ui.marginHint.mass: The launcher must be able to lift the whole spacecraft with its propellant.
ui.marginHint.budget: Total cost of the spacecraft and the launcher must fit the budget.
ui.waitHint: Waiting makes new modules cheaper, but the deadline gets closer and data from a late launch is worth less.
ui.result.title: Mission results
ui.result.pool: Total paid out: {pool} M$ (variety bonus x{diversity})
ui.result.missed: {agency} missed the deadline and contributed nothing.
ui.dev.title: Develop your own camera
ui.dev.hint: Order a camera with exactly the aperture you need. It costs money now and takes turns, and the factory may deliver a defect that you only see after launch (an inspection lowers the risk).
ui.dev.inspect: Order an inspection (costs more and takes a turn longer)
ui.dev.ready: ready, choose it in the camera slot
design.developed: Developed a custom camera with a {apertureM} m aperture for {costMUsd} M$ over {turns} turns.
design.defect: Production defect: the camera is {blurPercent}% blurrier than designed. It was launched without an inspection, and the risk of a defect was {chancePercent}%.
design.defectInspected: Production defect: the camera is {blurPercent}% blurrier than designed, even though it was inspected. The risk of a defect was {chancePercent}%.
ui.play.flightHint: Fix the station terminals before the timers run out. Drag to sling off the handles, E opens a terminal.
ui.play.skipFlight: Finish the flight and deploy the satellite
ui.play.lostFlightHint: The satellite was lost before deployment. Continue to the failure debrief.
ui.play.orbitHint: Set the switches and fly each orbit. The spacecraft is the one you built.
ui.play.orbitNotStarted: Orbit operations never started. Review the flight causes below before trying again.
ui.render.noWebgl: 3D view is unavailable: this browser or device does not support WebGL. The game still works with the controls below.
ui.designStage: Spacecraft on the test stand with the selected modules
ui.gallery.orbitState: Mock view: charge {charge}%, storm {storm}, link {link}, safe mode {safe}, status {status}
ui.menu.soloHint: You against three rival agencies run by the computer.
ui.lobby.onlyBots: At least one human player is needed.
ui.campaign.sendEarly: Finish early and send the report
ui.campaign.sendEarlyHint: Remaining orbits run on autopilot with the current switches.
ui.campaign.roundLine: {mb} Mb delivered, contribution {value}, payout {payout} M$ + grant {grant} M$, +{research} research
ui.campaign.awaiting: Window closed. Waiting for mission reports from: {players}
mission.disasterResponse.title: Disaster Response
mission.disasterResponse.brief: A flood has hit the delta. Rescuers need sharp, fresh images fast: a low orbit, a short mission, and data that loses value every turn.
mission.iceWatch.title: Ice Watch
mission.iceWatch.brief: Map polar ice over a long mission. Resolution matters less than volume, but the orbits are long and partly in shadow.
mission.bigEye.title: Big Eye
mission.bigEye.brief: Scientists want images sharper than any catalogue camera can take. Build your own mirror, and pray it is ground right.
mission.guest.title: The Guest
mission.guest.brief: An asteroid passes close to Earth, as Apophis will in April 2029. There are only a few launch windows: collect as much data as you can.
mission.selene.title: Selene
mission.selene.brief: Map the Moon from a low lunar orbit. Getting there costs a lot of delta-v, and passes over the relay are short.
scenario.livingPlanet.title: Living Planet
scenario.livingPlanet.brief: A five-window Earth observation programme. The baseline campaign.
scenario.disaster.title: Disaster Response
scenario.disaster.brief: Three short windows, data that goes stale fast.
scenario.iceWatch.title: Ice Watch
scenario.iceWatch.brief: Long missions, lots of data, long shadows.
scenario.bigEye.title: Big Eye
scenario.bigEye.brief: Only a custom mirror is sharp enough. Hubble-style defects included.
scenario.guest.title: The Guest
scenario.guest.brief: Two windows while an asteroid passes Earth. No target: grab all you can.
scenario.selene.title: Selene
scenario.selene.brief: A lunar mapping race where delta-v and short relay passes are the bottleneck.
research.testStand: Test stand: defect risk of own development ×0.7
research.earlyAccess: Supplier contracts: new modules appear 2 turns earlier for you
research.scouting: Scouting probe: learn the real mission conditions without a launch
research.series: Series production: relaunching the same design refunds 15%
ui.research.title: Research ({pts} points)
ui.research.hint: Points come from delivered data and from windows you skip. Research does not use up turn actions.
factory.line.alloy: Al-Li alloy → tanks and combustion chamber
factory.hint.alloy.bayer: Caustic digestion drops iron oxide out as red mud.
factory.hint.alloy.sinter: Binds silica before digestion; slower and hotter.
factory.hint.alloy.var: Boils off volatile copper and gases.
factory.hint.alloy.flux: Chlorine flux strips copper and some silica.
factory.hint.semi.siemens: Trichlorosilane distillation removes boron and iron.
factory.hint.semi.fz: Sweeps oxygen and boron out of the crystal.
factory.hint.cells.lime: Precipitates magnesium out of the brine.
factory.hint.cells.recryst: Grows clean cathode crystals; removes sodium.
factory.line.rf: Copper and rare earths → RF amplifier
factory.hint.rf.solvent: Separates thorium from the rare earths.
factory.hint.rf.ofhc: Copper cast under vacuum: no oxygen.
factory.hint.rf.zone: Slow sweep that removes sulfur and oxygen.
factory.hint.glass.magnetic: Pulls iron-bearing grains out of the sand.
factory.hint.glass.fine: Holds the melt hot so bubbles rise out.
factory.hint.glass.anneal: Weeks of controlled cooling relieve internal stress.
factory.hint.glass.polish: Figure the mirror; hides nothing inside the glass.
factory.hint.glass.hip: Squeezes out bubbles and stress; slow.
ui.factory.title: Factory
ui.factory.hint: Make a module yourself: pick raw material, then one step at each stage. Steps that cure the material's flaws raise quality; uncured flaws lower it. Cheap domestic ore with the right route matches imported quality.
ui.factory.busy: A workshop on this route is busy.
campaign.lostInFlight: The spacecraft was lost during the flight and never reached its orbit.
mission.stationResupply.title: Station Resupply
mission.stationResupply.brief: The station is running low. Pick one container (water, food, spare parts or an experiment), reach the station orbit and keep the spacecraft alive through the approach. Three containers of the same thing are worth less than a mix.
scenario.lifeline.title: Lifeline
scenario.lifeline.brief: Three short windows to keep a space station supplied. Coordinate what each agency brings.
